resources.string: SMS and MMS that only the person you write to can read: encrypted for the key their phone number means, signed by yours. No account, no server of ours — the phone network carries them and cannot open them.\n\nThis application holds no key and does no cryptography: it asks foodjis, which must be installed.
To show your conversations, this application needs to read the messages this phone holds, and your address book to name who they are with.
